author: National Geographic
description:
Antoni Porowski, star of Best of the World, sits down to answer the Nat Geo 9, nine questions spanning from "what would you tell your 9-year-old self" to "what are 5 words that you live by?" Get a chance to dive deeper into Antoni's life while he takes his turn on the yellow chair.
